storyCards.headline: Holiday: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Madonna's "Holiday" reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Holiday" is a song recorded by American singer Madonna for her 1983 self-titled debut album.

The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Immaculate Collection" (1990) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Immaculate Collection (1990).
